hook_text: 24 m of fence. One run gives chickens 11 square metres, another gives 36. Same fence!
clip_script: Karoo farm! Mr Botha has 24 m of fencing. Long and thin: 1 by 11, only 11 square metres. Squish it to 4 by 8: 32. Make a square, 6 by 6: 36 square metres! Same fence, way more space. Now flip it: 36 square metres as 1 by 36 needs 74 m of fence. The square needs just 24! And boxes? Same volume, but cube-like boxes use the least cardboard.
visual_style: A loop of fence reshaping on a dusty farm with chickens spreading out, then gift boxes unfolding into nets.
mood: Clever and surprising, like a puzzle reveal.
pacing: Fence reshaping in steps, a big reveal at the square, then quick box comparisons.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the surface area of a cereal box.
